definition: Dishonest behaviour involving concealed intentions or contradictory conduct.
author: Jane Austen
quote: If I were not afraid of judging harshly, I should be almost tempted to say, that there is a strong appearance of duplicity in all this.
example_sentence: His duplicity came out when both his girlfriends turned up at the same party.
